Current screenshot shows Firefox opened to the Thunderbird website instead of the Thunderbird mail client. To read the emails in the Important folder we need to switch back to Thunderbird Mail. 

```python
import pyautogui, time

# Click on Thunderbird Mail icon in the dock to bring up the mail client
pyautogui.moveTo(35, 133, duration=0.2)
pyautogui.click()
time.sleep(1)
```
